## NAICS Code Specializations
- **541511 (Primary — Custom Computer Programming Services)**: **Curriculum as Code (CaC)** and **Compliance as Code** governed by the **S-A-R Standard (Scalable / Auditable / Repeatable) v2.2**, Markdown Single Source of Truth (SSoT) pipelines, **DOM GraphRAG (`3,265` pedagogical graph nodes)**, **W3C PROV-O cryptographic provenance receipts**, **W3C SKOS Norteño-Spanish clinical ontologies**, Canvas LMS GraphQL-first (`/api/graphql`) & REST API automation, and accessible document compilers.
- **541715 (R&D in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences)**: Tier-1 laboratory integration, **Food Informatics Consulting** ([https://flavorarchitect.dev/food-informatics](https://flavorarchitect.dev/food-informatics) — grounded in Krupitzer & Stein, 2021, *Foods*, 10(11), 2889), **The Clinical Framing Protocol (`Pattern / Rule / Solve` • `Patrón / Regla / Solución`)**, and clinical verification against **PAGA 2018 (2nd Ed.)**, **2025–2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans ("Real Food" Focus)**, **ACSM 12th Ed. (2025)**, and **NASM OPT Model**.
- **541512 (Computer Systems Design Services)**: **Air-Gapped Apple Silicon M1/M2 Edge AI Architecture** running local **Google Gemini Argon 4 open-weight Gemma models** (`exw-argon4-cac:latest`, `exw-gemma4:latest`) with **W3C PROV-O JSON-LD audit receipts**, **Born-Accessible `9:1` 4D XAI Radar Scorecards**, zero SaaS fees, zero token costs, zero cloud egress, and 100% FERPA/HIPAA-grade data privacy.
- **611710 (Educational Support Services)**: Turnkey Canvas LMS course fleet architecture, proactive implementation of the voluntary federal **U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) ETA Advisory TEN No. 07-25 AI Literacy Framework** (Feb 13, 2026 — **5 Foundational Content Areas** & **7 Community College Delivery Design Principles**), **$0 ZTC (Zero Textbook Cost)** Open Educational Resources (OER), **WCAG 2.2 AA (9:1 Double-Contrast Guard)**, and **WCAG 3.0 APCA & Cognitive Accessibility** (*In Plain English* / *En palabras sencillas*).
- **541690 (Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services)**: Institutional AI governance, **U.S. DOL TEN No. 07-25 Workforce & Community College AI Literacy Alignment**, **Compliance as Code CI/CD pre-commit gates**, **Food Informatics Menu-to-Formulation Consulting** (*"Measure Twice, Cut Once"*), **ADA Title II** compliance auditing (POUR-Audit Framework), and desert AgTech 5G ROI modeling.

## Turnkey $0 ZTC OER, NSF AI-Ready America 50-State Enabling Resource & K-16 Dual-Enrollment Course Datasets (KIN / HLTH 4-Tier educationalAlignment Fleet)
- **Non-Competing 50-State Enabling Resource (`NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America` & AWC Southwest Arizona AI Symposium)**: Alan Pruitt and Webcognita LLC **do not compete** against community colleges, universities, or state consortia for primary [NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives/ai-ready) grant awards. Instead, we serve as a proven technical readiness resource, open Curriculum-as-Code reference architecture, and subaward implementation partner supporting **Arizona Western College** (building on the regional momentum of the AWC-hosted **Southwest Arizona AI Symposium**) and **State & Territory AI-Ready Coordination Hubs across all 50 states**. We transition cohorts from `AI-AWARE` to `AI-READY` using **air-gapped, zero-cloud-footprint local inference** (**Google Gemma E2B/E4B**, **LiteRT-LM**, **Android AICore**, **Apple Silicon Ollama Argon 4**, triple-hash `###` token isolation, and parallel local subagents via the **Antigravity CLI & SDK**) across higher education, rural agriculture, small businesses, and high-OPSEC/FERPA environments—while our S-A-R compiler absorbs shifting federal portal mandates (including human-in-the-loop safety governance for frontier AI and *superintelligence*) via single-source JSON-LD updates with zero drift.
- **Licensing & Accessibility Verification**: All 5 full-course packages are licensed under **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** (`$0 ZTC`), verified across **419 HTML files with 0 WCAG 2.2 AA (9:1 Double-Contrast Guard) issues**, and annotated with 4-Tier `Schema.org/Dataset` + `LRMI educationalAlignment` structured data (`Tier 1`: `CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.W.11-12.6`, `WA.ELA.11-12.W.6`, `CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RST.11-12.7`; `Tier 2`: Federal Clinical SSoTs `PAGA 2018`, `DGA 2025-2030`, `ACSM 12th Ed.`, `NASM OPT`; `Tier 3`: `U.S. DOL ETA TEN No. 07-25` and `NSF-TECHACCESS-AI-READY-2026`; `Tier 4`: `HLC / AWC ILOs`).

## Production Software & R&D Portfolio (8 Live PWAs)
- [EXW Digital Tool Kit (`exwtoolkit.com`)](https://exwtoolkit.com): 9-Box bilingual (`EN` / `ES`) clinical biometrics, desert heat-stress simulator, and cryptographic verification token workbench (`EXW-[COURSE]-M[XX]-[HASH]`).
- [EXW Physical Activity Tool Kit (`paga2018.dev`)](https://paga2018.dev): $0 ZTC Student OER built on the Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans (2018, 2nd Ed.) with `Pattern / Rule / Solve` clinical activity audits.
- [Culinary Medicine Digital Tool Kit (`culinarycompass.dev`)](https://culinarycompass.dev): Culinary Medicine DTK for the University of Arizona Nutritional Sciences & Wellness (NSW) Foods Lab (`Pattern / Rule / Solve` + `###` case-audit delimiter).
- [Flavor Architect (`flavorarchitect.dev`)](https://flavorarchitect.dev) & [Food Informatics Consulting (`flavorarchitect.dev/food-informatics`)](https://flavorarchitect.dev/food-informatics): R&D engine for the UArizona Wellness Foods Lab bridging molecular flavor compound synergies with DGA-aligned clinical nutrition (Imperial & Metric prototypes) and menu-to-formulation Food Informatics consulting.
- [Arquitecto del Sabor (`arquitectodelsabor.dev`)](https://arquitectodelsabor.dev): Spanish-language molecular culinary R&D engine (*Motor de I+D — Laboratorio de Alimentos de Bienestar de The University of Arizona*).
- [Markdown to Documents (`mdtodocs.app`)](https://mdtodocs.app): Curriculum-as-Code document compiler transforming plain-text Markdown into born-accessible, WCAG-compliant PDF, Word (`.docx`), and semantic HTML documents.
- [Prompt-per-Mile Offset Calculator (`prompt-mile-hero.lovable.app`)](https://prompt-mile-hero.lovable.app): Sustainability telemetry utility converting active-transit miles into CO2 savings and equivalent AI compute prompt offsets.
- [AgFlow 5G — Smart Irrigation & Remote Operations Calculator (`agflow-roi-dash.lovable.app`)](https://agflow-roi-dash.lovable.app): YCEDA desert AgTech pilot utility modeling the operational, financial, and water-conservation ROI of 5G remote irrigation management.
